description: This file defines the RequestHandler interface used in the WebDAV web application component of the OFBiz framework. It declares a single method handleRequest for processing HTTP requests in a WebDAV context.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A functional interface for handling WebDAV HTTP requests.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Method to handle a WebDAV request, given the HTTP request, response, and servlet context, possibly throwing ServletException or IOException.
